statement: The pinned Linux Nintendo Switch 2 code defines a mouse feature flag but its initialization enables buttons, analog controls and rumble, and its evdev registration/packet parser do not expose a mouse input. The inspected pinned SDL Switch 2 joystick driver has no mouse-event decoding path. This is a consumer-source gap; it does not establish the hardware mouse protocol.

applicability.scope: Mouse input handling in inspected Linux and SDL joystick consumer paths
